entries.title: Proverbs 12:1
segments: ¶Whoso loveth discipline loveth knowledge, but he that hateth reproof is brutish.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:2
segments: ¶A good [man] obtaineth favour of Jehovah; but a man of mischievous devices will he condemn.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:3
segments: ¶A man shall not be established by wickedness; but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:4
segments: ¶A woman of worth is a crown to her husband; but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:5
segments: ¶The thoughts of the righteous are right; the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:6
segments: ¶The words of the wicked are a lying-in-wait for blood; but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:7
segments: ¶Overthrow the wicked, and they are no [more]; but the house of the righteous shall stand.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:8
segments: ¶A man is commended according to his wisdom; but he that is of a perverted heart shall be despised.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:9
segments: ¶Better is he that is lightly esteemed, and hath a servant, than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:10
segments: ¶A righteous man is concerned for the life of his beast; but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:11
segments: ¶He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread; but he that followeth the worthless is void of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:12
segments: ¶The wicked desireth the net of evil [men]; but the root of the righteous yieldeth [fruit].

entries.title: Proverbs 12:13
segments: ¶In the transgression of the lips is an evil snare; but a righteous [man] shall go forth out of trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:14
segments: ¶A man is satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth; and the recompense of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:15
segments: ¶The way of a fool is right in his own eyes; but he that is wise hearkeneth unto counsel.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:16
segments: ¶The vexation of the fool is presently known; but a prudent [man] covereth shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:17
segments: ¶He that uttereth truth sheweth forth righteousness; but a false witness deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:18
segments: ¶There is that babbleth like the piercings of a sword; but the tongue of the wise is health.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:19
segments: ¶The lip of truth shall be established for ever; but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:20
segments: ¶Deceit is in the heart of them that devise evil; but to the counsellors of peace is joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:21
segments: ¶There shall no evil happen to a righteous [man]; but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:22
segments: ¶Lying lips are an abomination to Jehovah; but they that deal truly are his delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:23
segments: ¶A prudent man concealeth knowledge; but the heart of the foolish proclaimeth folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:24
segments: ¶The hand of the diligent shall bear rule; but the slothful [hand] shall be under tribute.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:25
segments: ¶Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop; but a good word maketh it glad.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:26
segments: ¶The righteous guideth his neighbour; but the way of the wicked misleadeth them.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:27
segments: ¶The slothful roasteth not what he took in hunting; but man's precious substance is to the diligent.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:28
segments: ¶In the path of righteousness is life, and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
